label: Hidden Gem Discovery Mode
summary: Create a dedicated mode for high-fit tracks from emerging artists, smaller catalogs, and songs outside the user's usual popularity band.

label: Repeat Fatigue Reset

summary: Let users tune how much fresh, unfamiliar music appears in recommendations so discovery does not collapse into the same tracks.

label: Mood-Based Discovery Paths

label: Popularity Filter in Search

label: Exclude Known Artists From Discovery

label: Monthly Discovery Goals
summary: Give users lightweight goals such as finding five new artists or saving ten unfamiliar tracks each month.
